gloss: to be useful, to be helpful

definitions.gloss: to be useful, to be helpful, to serve a purpose
definitions.explanation: To be of practical use or benefit to someone or something.

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}は{勉強|べんきょう}に{役立|やくだ}つ。
examples.english: This book is useful for studying.

examples.japanese: {将来|しょうらい}{役立|やくだ}つスキルを{身|み}につけたい。
examples.english: I want to acquire skills that will be useful in the future.

examples.japanese: あなたの{助言|じょげん}が{役立|やくだ}ちました。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive).

COMPOUND: {役|やく} (role, use) + {立|た}つ (to stand)

CONJUGATION (godan): {役立|やくだ}つ → {役立|やくだ}たない → {役立|やくだ}った → {役立|やくだ}って

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜に{役立|やくだ}つ (be useful for ~)
- 〜の{役|やく}に{立|た}つ (be useful for ~) - similar expression

RELATED:
- {役立|やくだ}てる (to put to use - transitive)
- {役|やく}に{立|た}つ (to be useful - common expression)
- {有益|ゆうえき} (beneficial, useful)
- {便利|べんり} (convenient, useful)
